description: This file defines the class BinaryProtocolCmd which contains a method to check for the existence of a specific definition file and shows a message if it is not found.

classes.name: BinaryProtocolCmd
classes.description: Contains static methods related to binary protocol commands, specifically checking for a definition file.

methods.name: checkForDefinitionFile
methods.description: Checks if the definition file exists; displays a message dialog if not and returns false, otherwise returns true.
